description: Implementation of the ProviderService interface for managing Provider entities in the OpenMRS platform, including CRUD operations, retrieval by various attributes, role management, and role assignment checks.

classes.name: ProviderServiceImpl
classes.description: Default implementation of ProviderService, providing database interaction, business logic, and transaction management for Provider entities in OpenMRS.

methods.name: setProviderDAO
methods.description: Sets the data access object used for direct database operations on Providers.

methods.name: getAllProviders
methods.description: Retrieves all Providers, with optional inclusion of retired providers.

methods.name: retireProvider
methods.description: Marks a Provider as retired (though implementation appears incomplete).

methods.name: unretireProvider
methods.description: Unretires a Provider, saving the updated state.

methods.name: purgeProvider
methods.description: Deletes a Provider from the database.

methods.name: getProvider
methods.description: Retrieves a Provider by its unique ID.

methods.name: saveProvider
methods.description: Saves or updates a Provider, also handling custom attributes.

methods.name: getProviderByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a Provider via its UUID.

methods.name: getProvidersByPerson
methods.description: Returns Providers associated with a specific Person, with optional inclusion of retired.

methods.name: getCountOfProviders
methods.description: Returns the count of Providers matching a query, with support for including retired Providers.

methods.name: getProviders
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Providers matching a query and attribute filters, with support for pagination.

methods.name: getAllProviderAttributeTypes
methods.description: Retrieves all ProviderAttributeTypes, optionally including retired.

methods.name: getProviderAttributeType
methods.description: Fetches a ProviderAttributeType by ID.

methods.name: getProviderAttributeTypeByUuid
methods.description: Fetches a ProviderAttributeType by UUID.

methods.name: getProviderAttributeTypeByName
methods.description: Fetches a ProviderAttributeType by name.

methods.name: saveProviderAttributeType
methods.description: Saves or updates a ProviderAttributeType.

methods.name: retireProviderAttributeType
methods.description: Marks a ProviderAttributeType as retired (implementation appears to just save the entity).

methods.name: unretireProviderAttributeType
methods.description: Unretires a ProviderAttributeType by saving it.

methods.name: purgeProviderAttributeType
methods.description: Deletes a ProviderAttributeType.

methods.name: isProviderIdentifierUnique
methods.description: Checks if a Provider's identifier is unique across the system.

methods.name: getProviderByIdentifier
methods.description: Fetches a Provider by its identifier string.

methods.name: getUnknownProvider
methods.description: Retrieves the special 'unknown' Provider based on a system-wide UUID.

methods.name: getProviderRole
methods.description: Fetches a ProviderRole by ID.

methods.name: getProviderRoleByUuid
methods.description: Fetches a ProviderRole by UUID.

methods.name: getProvidersByRoles
methods.description: Retrieves Providers associated with specified roles.

methods.name: getAllProviderRoles
methods.description: Retrieves all ProviderRoles, optionally including retired roles.

methods.name: saveProviderRole
methods.description: Saves or updates a ProviderRole.

methods.name: retireProviderRole
methods.description: Marks a ProviderRole as retired.

methods.name: unretireProviderRole
methods.description: Unretires a ProviderRole.

methods.name: purgeProviderRole
methods.description: Deletes a ProviderRole if it is not assigned to any Providers.
